title: X.509 Chain Inspector
description: Paste a PEM certificate chain, leaf first, and this page reads every certificate offline: subject, issuer, serial, validity against a date you set, SANs, key usage, extended key usage, basic constraints, SHA-256 fingerprint, and qcStatements decoded per ETSI EN 319 412-5 including the PSD2 roles statement of ETSI TS 119 495. Each issuer signature link is verified in the browser with WebCrypto. No revocation check and no trust decision: those need network or a policy anchor this page does not have. A #selftest=1 fragment runs three bundled chains end to end (valid PSD2 pair, expired leaf, broken signature link). Runs entirely in the browser, zero network, zero storage, deterministic.

pem_chain.description: One or more PEM certificates, leaf first

as_of.description: ISO date the validity windows are judged against, default today

mcp_tool_definition.name: inspect_x509_chain
mcp_tool_definition.description: Parses a pasted PEM X.509 chain leaf first and returns per-certificate fields (subject, issuer, serial, validity at a supplied as-of date, SANs, key usage, extended key usage, basic constraints, SHA-256 fingerprint, qcStatements per ETSI EN 319 412-5 with PSD2 roles per ETSI TS 119 495) plus a signature verdict for each issuer link, verified locally with WebCrypto. No revocation and no trust-store decision.

as_of.description: ISO date used for validity windows, e.g. 2026-06-15
